description: This file defines the TaskDatabase class for managing task data using SQLite via sqflite package. It includes methods for creating, reading, updating, and deleting tasks, and handles database initialization and schema creation.

classes.name: TaskDatabase
classes.description: Singleton class providing database operations for tasks, including initialization, CRUD operations, and connection management.

methods.name: database
methods.description: Getter that initializes and returns the database instance asynchronously.

methods.name: _initDB
methods.description: Initializes the database with the specified file path and creates schema if needed.

methods.name: _createDB
methods.description: Creates the tasks table with specified columns and types.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Inserts a new task into the database and returns the task with assigned ID.

methods.name: readNote
methods.description: Retrieves a task by its ID.

methods.name: readAllNotes
methods.description: Retrieves all tasks from the database.

methods.name: readSpecificTasks
methods.description: Retrieves tasks filtered by a specific list name.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing task in the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a task by its ID.
